summary: File open helper. Optionally runs an attribute pre-check on the supplied name (a2) gated by a5, stores the mode arguments into this+0x0C and this+0x10, clears the local path buffer, and opens the file through sub_587DB0 choosing the read-mode path global unk_5E517C or the write-mode path global unk_5E5180 depending on this+0x0C. Stores the handle at this+0x00, zeroes the byte at this+0x18, and when the handle is valid copies the resolved path string into this+0x04 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc. Returns whether the handle is non-null.

operations.description: When a5 is non-zero, FileAttributeCheckSequence(a2) must return non-zero to proceed; when a5 is zero the check is skipped and processing continues.
Store the mode arguments: this[3] (0x0C) = a4 and this[4] (0x10) = a3.
sub_568620(1024) clears the 1024-byte local path buffer before it is used.
When this[3] (mode) is non-zero, sub_587DB0 opens using the read-mode path global unk_5E517C; otherwise it opens using the write-mode path global unk_5E5180.
Store the handle returned by sub_587DB0 at this+0x00 and derive the success flag from it being non-zero.
Zero the byte at this+0x18 (offset 24) on the success path.
When the handle is valid, StringCopyWithBufferRealloc copies the resolved path buffer into this+0x04.
Return the handle-validity flag on the success path; on the early attribute-check exit, return the FileAttributeCheckSequence result.

unresolved: The exact purpose of the a5-gated FileAttributeCheckSequence and what it verifies about the file is unknown.
The distinct roles of a3 (stored at this+0x10) versus a4 (mode at this+0x0C) are not documented in this packet.
